observations: restore-info.json and the create checkpoint record EXP, iOS/cloudOS 26.1 build 23B85; variant alone does not identify RootHide.
The runtime marker PID 18728 was not present, and lsof found no Disk.img holder before attachment.
Disk.img was attached using hdiutil -readonly -nomount; only System and Preboot were mounted using mount_apfs -o rdonly,nobrowse.
The active Preboot directory contains jb-vphone/procursus and the .installed_dopamine and .procursus_strapped markers.

The installed /cores/vphone_jb_setup.sh selects /private/preboot/$BOOT_HASH/jb-vphone/procursus and creates /private/var/jb pointing to that root. This is evidence of the existing rootless installation layout.
Data and User APFS volumes were encrypted and locked. The current read-only examination cannot exclude a later additional RootHide installation in Data.
This examination did not inspect a live guest, execute services.start, or establish actual RootHide service behavior.
Both mounts were removed and the exact attached base disk6 was ejected. No VM was booted and no AMFI or TCC change was made.

All eight recorded file metadata tuples remained identical; seven small-file SHA-256 values remained identical. Disk.img was not fully hashed, so this result does not assert a full 64 GiB byte comparison.
next_requirement: A live guest readback proving an installed RootHide root and its service prerequisites, or a different known RootHide guest sample. The current final signed VM is blocked by AMFI, as separately recorded.
